issue.title: docs-check lint: docs/reference/vault-format.md over the 6000-word reference budget (6016) since bb91c370

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: `just docs-check` stops at lint on bob-cli master: `docs/reference/vault-format.md:1: budget: over budget at 6016 words (cap 6000 for reference/)`. It is deterministic, not a flake: `bob_docs.markdown.count_words` gives 5983 words at 1fa1b4e7, 5999 at f9b0e2ed, and 6016 at bb91c370 ("feat(albums): read frontmatter title first and add bob albums tidy"), which crossed the cap. Two runs on apollo failed identically, and the failure blocks every later docs-check stage (generated drift, strict build, links, search, tutorial, media) for all bob-cli and mounted-repo docs work. The fix is to trim or move at least 17 words of vault-format.md (or split the page) without losing contract facts; per docs.md, behavior facts stay in the reference.

issue.creation_reason: just docs-check fails at lint on master because bb91c370 pushed vault-format.md past the reference word cap, which hides every later docs gate for unrelated docs work.
